ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Ashika Global Securities Limited reported a standalone profit of INR 7,755.89 lakhs for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, driven by strong interest/dividend income and significant deleveraging, as evidenced by a drastic reduction in financial liabilities. However, the second quarter alone registered a material loss of INR 1,315.81 lakhs, primarily due to extreme volatility from a substantial 'Net loss on fair value changes.' Investors should note that prior-period comparative figures were restated following an amalgamation and were management-certified but not auditor-reviewed, impacting direct comparability.
